## Decision

Make divergence loud on WRITE, not only on READ. The existing STORE_DIVERGENCE guard fires on gw journal show, which is the path nobody runs. The silent-success condition lives on the write path.

## Rationale

bin/journal append and every hook succeed while writing to an unread store. Strengthening the read guard only was rejected — it does not address silent success. Making writes fail hard was rejected — it would break every hook mid-session.

## Alternatives Considered

- Strengthen the read guard only — rejected, does not address write-site silent success
- Make writes fail hard — rejected, breaks every hook mid-session
